title: Section C E5: inclusion is decided at one confirmation with no reorg handling; a reorged-out buy or sell stays recorded as included and its hash is never re-checked

evidence.note: the first receipt with status 1 returns included at once (no confirmation depth)
a native confirm returns the hash at once
Flashbots native confirm = the bundle hash is in block targetBlock right after that block arrives (library BundleIncluded, 0 extra confirmations)
only the passthrough native confirm waits for 3 confirmations (and with no timeout, AUD-TX-002)

sibling_sites_checked: Every inclusion decision in the slice (reconciliation.ts:373-378, :405-407, :569-573; flashbots.ts:319; passthrough.ts:141). Consumers outside the slice: exit teardown on one balance read (AUD-EXIT-020), factory events at chain head (AUD-BUY-019).
severity_rationale: S3: post-merge Ethereum and the L2 sequencers reorg rarely and shallowly, so the condition is uncommon; when it hits, a reorged-out sell is treated as done (position untracked while still held, AUD-EXIT-020) or a reorged-out buy is recorded with a hash that never mined. Section C candidate (no RC), origin research-candidate with an empty rc list.
recommendation: Phase 29 unless Phase 24 decides otherwise on card TX-01: record the inclusion block hash and re-check it after N blocks (or require N confirmations before teardown), with N per chain.
